# Nelson Iheagwam Ministries

> Nelson Iheagwam Ministries is a Christian ministry helping people come to the saving knowledge of Jesus Christ, grow through sound teaching of Scripture, and become equipped for the work of ministry.

Canonical website: https://www.niministries.org/

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.niministries.org/): Ministry introduction, upcoming events, vision, mission, recent sermons, partnership information, and newsletter signup.
- [About Us](https://www.niministries.org/about-us): The ministry's identity, mandate, vision, and leadership.
- [Resources](https://www.niministries.org/resources): Sermons and Christian teaching resources with links to audio and video platforms.
- [Meet Pastor Nelson Iheagwam](https://www.niministries.org/meet-pni): Biography and official social profiles for the ministry lead.
- [Contact and Booking](https://www.niministries.org/contact-us): Contact the ministry or invite Pastor Nelson Iheagwam to speak at a meeting.
- [One Special Meeting 2026](https://www.niministries.org/event/osm-2026): Event information and free registration for the 19 September 2026 meeting at The Envoys, Ogba.

## Key topics

- The gospel of Jesus Christ and salvation.
- Christian discipleship and spiritual growth.
- Sound biblical teaching and apologetics.
- Prayer, devotion, and the work of the Holy Spirit.
- Equipping believers for ministry.
- Sermons, ministry events, and pastoral invitations.

## Official contact

- Email: contact@niministries.org
- Website: https://www.niministries.org/
